Configuring and managing a Multi-AZ deployment for Amazon RDS Multi-AZ deployments can have one standby or two standby DB instances [1]. A Multi-AZ DB instance deployment has one standby DB instance that provides failover support, but doesn't serve read traffic [1]. A Multi-AZ DB cluster deployment has standby DB instances that provide failover support and can also serve read traffic [1]. A Multi-AZ DB instance deployment has only one row for the DB instance, com Role sendo Instance ou Primary e Multi-AZ sendo Yes [2]. Uma Multi-AZ DB cluster deployment tem uma linha no nível do cluster com três linhas de DB instance abaixo dela [2].
